selection_rule: advance taxonomy-v2 to the frozen train holdout only if full-valid macro-F1 is strictly greater than the committed taxonomy reference, errors equal zero, invalid outputs do not increase, and paired analysis does not reveal a severe rare-class regression
holdout_policy: the 2,329-row frozen train holdout remains unopened and unscored during this run
publishing_boundary: aggregate valid analysis only; row-level files remain private and ignored
